description: Saskatoon's Public Art Program includes 85 civic artworks.
Public art is funded by 1% of designated capital projects.
The Place Maker program engages public with art.

chips.text: Place Maker program works with Business Improvement Districts.

description: Public Art Advisory Committee appoints Chair and Vice-Chair for 2026.

description: Committee will not consider bird deterrents at City Hall.

description: Committee must submit a 2026 work plan draft by March 31, 2026.
